name: Jar by Jar
intro:
⚠️ BEFORE STEP 1 — check you are in a test copy. Look for the small “🧪 Test copy” mark on the screen. It means this app has never seen you, which is what the steps below expect. If it is missing and the app already shows your own information, you have opened your real app: go back to your list and tap this app's name again, rather than using a bookmark, your history, or an icon on your home screen. Starting in the wrong copy makes the early steps look broken when nothing is wrong.

Jar by Jar is a family budget in jars. You will look around an example family, spend from a jar, let a jar run over and cover it, change the plan, then put the example away and start your own month. Then we check it remembers everything after a reload and with no internet. All the money here is pretend.

steps.do: A white card at the bottom says “Welcome to Jar by Jar”. Tap the small words “skip the tour” in its bottom-right corner.
steps.see: The card now asks “How do you want to start?” with two choices: “🧪 Keep the examples to play with” and “✨ Start fresh with my own”.

steps.do: Tap “🧪 Keep the examples to play with”.
steps.see: A yellow card at the top says “👀 This is an example family, the Walkers. Try anything — it’s pretend money.” with a “Start my own month” button. Under it a green line says “✓ Every dollar has a jar.”, then the jars, two to a row, starting with 🙏 Give marked “first jar”.

steps.do: Scroll down a little and tap the 🛒 Groceries jar.
steps.see: A card opens titled “🛒 Groceries”. It says “Planned $760”, shows $233.37 “left in this jar”, and lists four shopping trips — Costco, Kroger, Aldi and Kroger, newest at the top — each with a ✕.

steps.do: Tap “Close” at the bottom of that card.
steps.see: The card closes and you are back at the jars.

steps.do: Tap the big orange “− I spent money” button at the bottom of the screen.
steps.see: A card titled “I spent money” opens with a big “$0”, number keys from 1 to 9, and under them “From which jar?” with a button for every jar.

steps.do: Tap the keys 2 and then 5. Then, without tapping a jar, tap “Take it out of the jar”.
steps.see: The big number says $25. A dark message at the bottom says “Tap the jar it came from.” and nothing is saved yet.

steps.do: Tap “🛒 Groceries” in the jar buttons. Tap the “What for?” box, type the words below, then tap “Take it out of the jar”.
steps.see: The card closes, the Groceries jar flashes gold, and a message says “$25 out of Groceries · $208.37 left”. The Groceries jar now shows $208.37.

steps.do: Tap the 🛒 Groceries jar again.
steps.see: Mary's birthday cake is at the top of the list, spelled right with its apostrophe, at $25. Tap “Close”.

steps.do: Tap “− I spent money”. Tap the keys 4 and 0, tap “🍔 Eating out”, then tap “Take it out of the jar”.
steps.see: About a second later a card says “🍔 Eating out is over by $20.95” and “That’s all right — it happens.” Its big button says “Cover it from 👛 Pocket money ($162.20 left)”.

steps.do: Tap “Cover it from 👛 Pocket money”.
steps.see: A message says “Moved $20.95 from Pocket money to Eating out”. The 🍔 Eating out jar now says “all used” and 👛 Pocket money shows $141.25.

steps.do: Scroll down below the jars and tap “📝 Plan the month”.
steps.see: A card titled “Plan the month” opens. “What comes in this month” says 4850, a green line says “✓ Every dollar has a jar.”, and each jar has a line with its name and amount (Give 485, Save 300, House 1450…).

steps.do: Tap the 4850 box, delete it, and type the number below.
steps.see: The line changes to yellow and says “$150 still needs a jar.”

steps.do: Tap “🙏 Give = 10% of what comes in”.
steps.see: The Give amount becomes 500, and the line says “$135 still needs a jar.”

steps.do: Tap “＋ Add a jar”. A small box asks for a name: type the word below and tap OK.
steps.see: The plan opens again with a new line at the bottom, 🏖 Vacation, with 0. What comes in still says 5000 and Give still says 500.

steps.do: Tap the 0 beside 🏖 Vacation, delete it, type 135, then tap “Save the plan”.
steps.see: Before you save, the line turns green: “✓ Every dollar has a jar.” After saving, a message says “Plan saved · every dollar has a jar”, and a 🏖 Vacation jar with $135 is last in the jars.

steps.do: Scroll down and tap “💬 Talk it over”.
steps.see: A card shows a plain summary that starts “Our jars —” and this month’s name, with one line for each jar, then “Given this year:”. The buttons are “Send it”, “🖨 Print” and “Close”. Tap “Close” — nothing is sent unless you send it.

steps.do: Tap “⚙️ Settings”. In the box under “Money”, choose KSh. Then tap “Close”.
steps.see: Every amount now starts with KSh — for example the Vacation jar says KSh 135.

steps.do: Tap “⚙️ Settings” again, choose $ under “Money”, and tap “Close”. Then pull the page down to reload it (or tap ↻ in Safari).
steps.see: After the reload the 🏖 Vacation jar is still there with $135, and Groceries still shows $208.37. If a “What would you like to do?” card comes up, tap “🫙 My jars” — that is the start menu, and it is right.
steps.tip: The start menu only comes on some opens, so if no card appears, that is right too.

steps.do: Turn on Airplane Mode (swipe down from the top-right corner, tap ✈️). Tap “＋ Money in”, type 100 on the keys, type the words below in “What was it?”, and tap “Add it”.
steps.see: A yellow strip says “No connection right now — the app still works and saves on this phone.” A message says “$100 came in”, and the first number at the top goes up by $100 (from $2,425 to $2,525).

steps.do: Turn Airplane Mode off. Scroll to the top and tap “Start my own month” in the yellow card.
steps.see: A small box asks “Put the example family away and start your own month?” with Cancel and OK.

steps.do: Tap “OK”.
steps.see: The Walkers are gone. “Plan the month” opens with seven jars — Give, Save, House, Groceries, Bills, Car & gas and Pocket money — all at 0, and the line says “Type what comes in this month first.”

steps.do: In “What comes in this month”, delete the 0 and type 3000. Tap “🙏 Give = 10% of what comes in”, then tap “Save the plan”.
steps.see: The main screen shows your seven jars, 🙏 Give first with $300 and the “first jar” mark, and the line says “$2,700 still needs a jar.” with a “Fix the plan” button. The yellow example card is gone. The bottom of the page says “Jar by Jar v1.0 · 2026-11-13”. Two steps left.

steps.do: Now the videos. This app has 3. Open each one and watch it right through, sound on: Explain it to me — https://jerrywins1.github.io/daraja-apps/shop/watch.html?app=jarbyjar&mode=firsttime  Watch it work — https://jerrywins1.github.io/daraja-apps/shop/watch.html?app=jarbyjar  Train me — https://jerrywins1.github.io/daraja-apps/shop/watch.html?app=jarbyjar&mode=train
steps.see: Each one talks without stopping — no long silences, no sentence starting again. The screen behind the words changes to match what is being said, and when it points at something, that thing is really there. If a video talks about a button or a screen you did not see in this app, say so — that is a real fault and one of the most useful things you can find.

steps.do: Last, the shop page everyone sees: https://jerrywins1.github.io/daraja-apps/shop/ — find Jar by Jar on the “Your household” shelf and read its card.
steps.see: The name and the one-line description match the app you just used. The card says Coming soon, and that is right: Jar by Jar joins the store when it passes testing. Nothing on the card promises something the app does not do. If the card and the app disagree, the card is the fault — say which bit.
